method: Read rendered SharePoint pages and inventories using the signed-in browser. No hidden APIs, cookies, or authentication tokens were exported.
scope: All 15 listed Site Pages were opened, including the duplicate landing page and default SharePoint template. Useful page guidance summarized; linked document titles indexed.
limitations: Full DOCX/PDF/presentation/Box contents were not extracted.
Document library view labeled All Documents remained filtered to Incident; no claim of a complete library inventory.
No recursive crawl of external resource sites.
Anchor and Passive Program List links reported unavailable in the current Box session. Active Program List contents were not inspected.
Historical August calendar entries were not exported; the displayed October week had zero events.
excluded_from_publication: personal contact details and staff profiles
raw browser captures and account identity
Box shared access URLs and opaque reservation parameters
notes: Public repo contains curated summaries and authenticated source pointers. It does not grant access to the original restricted sources.
